newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Kemira 4-mth profit seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Kemira 4-mth profit seen down.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 365 million markka median forecast for Finnish chemicals and fertiliser group Kemira Oy's January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecasts by 11 analysts, EPS by five analysts).
Kemira's four-month results are due on June 9 by midday (about 0900 GMT).
In January-April 1996, Kemira posted a profit before extraordinaries and tax of 477 million markka.
In April, Kemira said it expected first-tertial earnings to be below the year-ago period, but full-year earnings to be almost at the 1996 level.
The median of seven analysts' forecasts for Kemira's full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 853 million markka (mean 854 million) in a 752-925 million markka range.
In 1996, Kemira's profit was 851 million markka.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, Handelsbanken, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities and Postipankki.
